mapper.select: WITH input(user_id,fingerprint,at,ip,upload,download) AS MATERIALIZED ( VALUES (#{uid}::bigint,#{r.key}::uuid,#{r.moment}::timestamptz,#{r.ip}::inet,#{r.upload}::bigint,#{r.download}::bigint) ), observed AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ua.owner,i.fingerprint,i.at FROM input i JOIN userapps_heartbeat hb ON hb.ip=i.ip AND hb.first_seen_at <= i.at AND hb.last_seen_at >= i.at-(#{heartbeatWindowMillis}::bigint * interval '1 millisecond') JOIN userapp ua ON ua.id=hb.userapp_id WHERE ua.owner <> i.user_id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_account_deletion_request d WHERE d.user_id=ua.owner AND d.status='COMPLETED') ), added AS ( INSERT INTO user_career_events(user_id,kind,fingerprint,observed_at) SELECT user_id,'ban',fingerprint,at FROM input UNION ALL SELECT owner,'observation',fingerprint,at FROM observed ORDER BY 1,2,3 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING user_id,kind,fingerprint,observed_at ) SELECT a.user_id,(a.observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN a.kind='ban' THEN i.upload ELSE 0 END) AS upload, SUM(CASE WHEN a.kind='ban' THEN i.download ELSE 0 END) AS download, SUM(CASE WHEN a.kind='observation' THEN i.download ELSE 0 END) AS upload_ack, SUM(CASE WHEN a.kind='observation' THEN i.upload ELSE 0 END) AS download_ack, SUM(CASE WHEN a.kind='ban' THEN i.upload ELSE 0 END) AS loss, 0::numeric AS seeding,0::numeric AS downloading,0::bigint AS swarm_events, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.kind='ban') AS ban_events, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.kind='observation') AS observation_events FROM added a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (fingerprint) * FROM input ORDER BY fingerprint) i USING(fingerprint) GROUP BY 1,2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_lifetime_traffic AS t(user_id,sent_self,received_self,sent_ack,received_ack,tracked_since,history_partial,updated_at) SELECT user_id,SUM(upload),SUM(download),SUM(upload_ack),SUM(download_ack),now(),TRUE,now() FROM (VALUES (#{r.userId}::bigint,#{r.upload}::numeric,#{r.download}::numeric,#{r.uploadAck}::numeric,#{r.downloadAck}::numeric) ) AS v(user_id,upload,download,upload_ack,download_ack) GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(upload+download+upload_ack+download_ack)>0 ORDER BY user_id ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET sent_self=t.sent_self+EXCLUDED.sent_self, received_self=t.received_self+EXCLUDED.received_self,sent_ack=t.sent_ack+EXCLUDED.sent_ack, received_ack=t.received_ack+EXCLUDED.received_ack,updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at

INSERT INTO user_career_daily AS d(user_id,day,kind,amount) SELECT user_id,day,kind,SUM(amount) FROM (VALUES
(#{r.userId}::bigint,#{r.day}::date,#{r.kind}::text,#{r.amount}::bigint) ) AS v(user_id,day,kind,amount) GROUP BY user_id,kind,day ORDER BY user_id,kind,day ON CONFLICT(user_id,kind,day) DO UPDATE SET amount=d.amount+EXCLUDED.amount
mapper.select: WITH input(fingerprint,at) AS (VALUES (#{r.key}::uuid,#{r.moment}::timestamptz)), added AS ( INSERT INTO user_career_events(user_id,kind,fingerprint,observed_at) SELECT a.owner,'feature',i.fingerprint,i.at FROM userapp a CROSS JOIN input i WHERE a.id=#{uid} ORDER BY i.fingerprint ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING user_id,kind,observed_at ) SELECT user_id,(observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day,kind,COUNT(*) AS amount FROM added GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3,2
